name: otforge
description: Open-source ICS/SCADA cybersecurity training platform — Electron + Docker
author: Ian Burres <iburres@att.net>

scripts.predev: npm install --legacy-peer-deps --no-package-lock && node scripts/apply-pending-update.mjs && node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=packages/app
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/schema && npm run build --workspace=packages/app
scripts.build:win: npm run build:schema && npm run build:win --workspace=packages/app
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:schema && npm run build:mac --workspace=packages/app
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:schema && npm run build:linux --workspace=packages/app
scripts.build:packages: npm run build:schema && npm run build:orchestrator && npm run build:fw-analyzer
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=packages/orchestrator && npm run test --workspace=packages/fw-analyzer
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/schema && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/app && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/fw-analyzer
scripts.docker:clean: docker image prune -f && docker builder prune -f
